style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, bright daylight, camera always moving
motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses or fills the frame: a flying tag, her head, her ears or the camera; never a second where only the mouth moves
camera_moves: wide at 0.0, macro of her eye at 5.3, snaps wide at 8.4; moves on 2.4, 5.3, 8.4 only
tag_flights: a plastic ear tag flies in from off-frame, huge and close past the lens, and clips onto an ear at 0.6, 1.4, 2.0, 3.5, 4.4, 7.2, 8.6
character: a fluffy alpaca with a long neck and an absurd fringe over her eyes, buck teeth, permanently mild and puzzled
props: EAR TAGS: bright plastic livestock tags, each with a simple embossed pictogram — a bell, a heart, a play triangle, a star; no letters anywhere. They pile up on both ears through the clip: two at 0.6, a dozen by 5.3, a swaying mass by 8.6. MIC: furry windshield mic bottom right, never touched
prop_continuity: ears bare at 0.0; tags only ever arrive, never fall off or vanish; the last and biggest tag lands at 8.6 and stays
environment: a sunlit mountain pasture, green grass, blue sky, snowy peaks far behind
lighting: blazing high-altitude noon, hard sun, crisp shadows, high exposure, the plastic tags catching bright specular flashes

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: mild puzzled female voice, calm, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: one pause only, 6.5-7.0; the 3.8 and 5.3 lines run together with no breath; voiceless after 8.4, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a plastic clack on every tag landing, the clacks speeding up through the clip, a heavy wooden clatter at 8.6

timeline.a: silent. Two tags whip in past the lens and clack onto her ears; her whole head jerks sideways with the hit
she walks straight at the lens until her head fills the frame; two more tags fly in and clack on as she comes
a tag sails the full width of the frame past her nose; her head tracks it all the way across and it clacks onto the far ear
silent. She shakes her head hard: the whole load of tags swings out sideways like a curtain and clatters back
same sentence, no breath. Tags now arrive in a stream, three at once from three directions, each clacking on; her ears sag lower with every one
macro on one enormous eye behind the fringe, dead still into the lens, tags clacking on just out of shot
silent, the only pause. She turns her head slowly and looks at her own ear: a dozen tags hang there, swaying
she lifts her head to protest and the mass of tags drags it back down; she fights it up again, tags swinging across the whole frame
silent. The camera snaps wide: a small alpaca under a swaying mountain of plastic
silent. One last tag, twice the size of the rest, drops in from the top of the frame and clacks on; her head sinks all the way to the grass and stays there, eye still on the lens

must_appear: tags fly past the lens and clack onto her ears seven times, the load grows all clip and never shrinks, the head sinks to the grass at 8.6, pictograms only — no letters or numbers
negative_prompt: night, dusk, dark scene, low key, indoors, letters, numbers, words, logos, readable text on the tags, subtitles, watermark, a tag falling off, ears empty after 0.6, a second alpaca, people, hands, other animals, locked-off camera, static shot, slow motion, speed ramp, any voice from her after 8.4, silence in the tail, accented Russian, drawn-out delivery, swallowed endings, grain, fog, sepia
